name: drone-cli
description: drone-cli — Drone CI command line interface. Trigger builds, view logs, manage pipelines. Interact with Drone CI server.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/harness/drone-cli/releases/latest/download/drone_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf drone_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv drone /usr/local/bin/ && rm drone_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.

commands.description: drone-cli — Drone CI command line interface. Trigger builds, view logs, manage pipelines. Interact with Drone CI server.
